persona: 28 岁外企行政专员，约 B1：语法基本正确、连接词使用自然、词汇普通；阅读偏弱。第 5 天起因英文周报压力产出退化回避复杂句。

scenarioTexts: Last week I gave a short talk at work. Although I was nervous, I prepared well because the topic mattered to me. When I finished, my manager said that my ideas were clear. I felt proud of myself.
Yesterday my friend missed the bus, so he was late for class. Because the traffic was heavy, he decided to walk. When he arrived, the teacher had already started, but she smiled and let him in.
If I have free time this weekend, I will visit my grandmother, because she lives alone. Although the trip is long, I always enjoy it. We usually cook together while we talk about family news.

freeExpressions.text: Today was busy but interesting. Although I had many meetings, I still finished my weekly report on time, because I planned my morning carefully. When my manager read it, she said my English was getting better. I felt encouraged, so I will keep writing in English every day.
